meta.title: Ikoranabuhanga: software, IT na mudasobwa — Linse
meta.description: Linse ikora imbuga za interineti, porogaramu (apps) na sisitemu z'ubucuruzi, igurisha mudasobwa kandi ikita kuri IT y'ibigo mu Rwanda hose.

hero.title: IT yose, ahantu hamwe.
hero.sub: Linse ikora kandi yubaka porogaramu, igasohora ibicuruzwa byayo, igatanga ibikoresho by’ibigo kandi ikabikomeza gukora — kuva i Kigali, ku bw’Afurika.

statement.text: Dukora, twubaka kandi dutunga porogaramu ikigo cyawe gikoresha, kandi tugatanga ibikoresho byo kuyikoresha.

supply.blurb: Dushaka kandi dukwirakwiza mudasobwa, seriveri n’umuyoboro by’ibirango byizewe mu gihugu hose, hamwe na garanti yo hano.

support.title: Bikoreshwa, bikurikiranwa, bifashwa
support.blurb: Dukoresha, dukurikirana kandi dufasha ibyo dutanga n’ibyo usanganywe, mu masezerano amwe afite igihe cyo gusubiza cyumvikanyweho.

award.headline:
Twubatse kandi ducunga MacyePay,
urubuga rwo kwishyura mu byiciro
rumaze kunyuzwamo [RWF 500M+]
award.explainer: Kwishyura mu byiciro ku bucuruzi bwo mu Rwanda. Buri gahunda ni amasezerano yemejwe na noteri; kwibutsa, ibihano no gukurikirana bikorwa byikora, kandi amateka yo kwishyura yubaka amanota y'icyizere ya buri mukiriya.

products.softwareBlurb: Sisitemu twubaka, dutunga kandi ducunga ku isoko.
products.hardwareBlurb: Itangwa ryemewe ry’ibikoresho by’ibigo, hamwe na garanti n’ubufasha aho uri.

items.a: Twoherereze incamake ngufi unyuze kuri “Tangira umushinga”. Dusubiza mu minsi ibiri y’akazi n’ibibazo, hanyuma tugatanga igitekerezo gifite igihe n’igiciro.
Yego. Buri mushinga uza n’amahitamo y’ubufasha: gukurikirana, kuvugurura, guhosting na help desk ifite igihe cyo gusubiza cyumvikanyweho.
Yego. Dutanga kandi dushyiraho mu Rwanda hose, tukanohereza mu karere bisabwe. Garanti icungwa natwe, hano.
Ni cyo dukora cyane: guhuza ERP, HMIS, kwishyura na sisitemu za Leta kugira ngo zisangire amakuru neza.
Yego. Ibicuruzwa dusohora, nka MacyePay, biboneka ku ruhushya cyangwa nka serivisi icungwa natwe.
I Kigali, mu Rwanda. Dukorana n’abakiriya bo mu Burasirazuba bw’Afurika no kure.
